name: Run easy aerobic 40
description: An easy aerobic run on a gentle grade: the base of the running plans, and the recovery run between hard days. Needs the console in running mode and --running-mode.

ramp.name: Warm-up
ramp.notes: Easy jog or brisk walk, relaxed shoulders.

steps.name: Easy run
steps.notes: RPE 3-4. Conversational; nose breathing if you can.

ramp.name: Cooldown
ramp.notes: Walk it off; let the breathing settle.
